title: Vending machine transaction
goal: Show coin acceptance, guarded selection, dispensing, and refund behavior.

rubric.must: The initial marker visibly enters Idle, then coin insertion enters AcceptingCoins.
Selecting is visibly drawn as a composite state containing CheckStock and Dispensing.
The selection transition visibly carries a credit-at-least-price guard.
Available stock visibly leads from CheckStock to Dispensing and then completes the transaction.
Cancel and unavailable-item paths visibly lead to Refunding and then Idle.
AcceptingCoins has a visible self-loop for adding credit.
